title: 2018 HMMT November Guts Problem 2
statement: Pascal has a triangle. In the \(n\)th row, there are \(n+1\) numbers \(a_{n, 0}, a_{n, 1}, a_{n, 2}, \ldots, a_{n, n}\) where \(a_{n, 0}=a_{n, n}=1\). For all \(1 \leq k \leq n-1, a_{n, k}=a_{n-1, k}-a_{n-1, k-1}\). What is the sum of all numbers in the 2018th row?

solutions.text:
Answer: 2
In general, the sum of the numbers on the \(n\)th row will be

\[\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_{n, k}=a_{n, 0}+\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}\left(a_{n-1, k}-a_{n-1, k-1}\right)+a_{n, n}=a_{n, 0}+\left(a_{n-1, n-1}-a_{n-1,0}\right)+a_{n, n}=2\]
